events.topic: Yemeni civil war / Houthi–Saudi conflict / October 2026 attacks on Saudi Arabia airports
events.text: The Houthis claim to have attacked King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with a ballistic missile for a third consecutive day.
American economists Robert Ernest Hall and Michael Dean Woodford are jointly awarded the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for "microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilisation".

Two deaths are reported after hurricanes Rachel and Simon battered Mexico's coast, including a 71-year-old man and a young girl, with Guerrero governor Evelyn Salgado and Baja California governor Marina del Pilar Ávila confirming their deaths.
One person is killed and four others are injured after an accident on the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia in Mableton, Georgia, United States.
A fire destroys the historic Marché des Enfants-Rouges food market in Paris, France.
A 14-year-old student opens fire at a middle school in Aubagne, France, injuring two staff members, before being detained.

Pakistan's federal government detains hundreds of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) members, including former Khyber Pakhtunkhwa chief minister Sohail Afridi and other provincial officials, after suspending the PTI-led provincial administration and imposing emergency rule.
A cyber attack without attribution against French supermarkets results in losses worth millions of euros.
Ülle Madise, who was elected by the Riigikogu last 2 September, takes office as President of Estonia, succeeding Alar Karis.
